I am Dr.Hafiz Manzoor Ahmad Veterinary Surgeon! 🐾 As a dedicated veterinary surgeon with years of experience, I'm here to share valuable insights, tips, and techniques to ensure the health and happiness of your beloved pets. From routine check-ups to surgical procedures, join me on this channel for informative videos covering a wide range of topics in veterinary care. Whether you're a fellow professional in the field or a devoted pet parent seeking trusted advice, you'll find valuable resources here to enhance the well-being of our furry friends. Don't forget to subscribe and hit the notification bell to stay updated on the latest uploads. Let's work together to give our pets the best possible care they deserve! 🐶🐱" 
If you want contact Me
